verified_facts.text: The hotel is set on a 700-acre resort in the Rocky Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on a 700-acre luxury resort in the spectacular Rocky Mountains, Fairmont Jasper Park Lodge is one of the top hotels in Jasper, Canada.

verified_facts.text: The setting is between peaks, pine forests and Lac Beauvert, and the property offers rooms, suites and Signature Cabins.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a breathtaking setting between towering peaks, pine forests, and crystal-clear Lac Beauvert, this hideaway offers inviting rooms, suites and Signature Cabins

verified_facts.text: The hotel rooms are chalet-style, with Rocky Mountain or Lac Beauvert views, in Alberta's Jasper National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy cozy chalet-style hotel rooms with stunning Rocky Mountain or Lac Beauvert views in Alberta’s Jasper National Park.

verified_facts.text: The resort has an 18-hole golf course designed by Stanley Thompson.
The Marmot Basin ski area is 20km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just 20km away, Marmot Basin boasts the highest base elevation of any major Canadian ski area

verified_facts.text: The Viewpoint three-bedroom cabin has a kitchen, games room, sauna and enclosed veranda.
verified_facts.excerpt: Resort residential-style cabin. 3 King bedrooms, 4 bathrooms. Personalized Concierge, kitchen, games room, sauna, enclosed veranda, designated parking

verified_facts.text: The Athabasca Cabin has wooded resort views and an ensuite bathroom with a soaker tub, and is described as ideal for couples.
verified_facts.excerpt: Quaint cabin for a mountain getaway, ideal for couples. Wooded resort views, ensuite bathroom with soaker tub, Personalized Concierge, designated parking.

verified_facts.text: The Luxury Lakefront one-bedroom suites sit along the 18th fairway of the golf course and have a wood fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: located along the 18th fairway of the golf course. Theses suites have a large living area, wood fireplace

verified_facts.text: The One Bedroom Suite Bayview is along the lake and has bunk beds and a private furnished patio, described as ideal for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: suite located along the lake. Ideal for families with bunk beds, a private furnished patio, two bathrooms, and a separate living area.

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Main Lodge King rooms are on the second floor of the Main Lodge and have a private balcony with views of Lac Beauvert.
verified_facts.excerpt: located on the second floor of the Main Lodge, these rooms have a private balcony with views of Lac Beauvert.

verified_facts.text: The Ridgeline three-bedroom cabin has a gas fireplace, kitchen, patio and washer-dryer.
verified_facts.excerpt: living area, gas fireplace, kitchen, patio. Personalized Concierge, washer-dryer, designated parking

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite Wood Stove rooms are in Crosby Cabin, with a separate living area, a double sofabed and cabin or woodland views.
verified_facts.excerpt: suites located in Crosby Cabin. All rooms have a separate living area with a double sofabed and cabin or woodland views

verified_facts.text: The Fairmont Main Lodge King rooms are on the first floor of the Main Lodge and have limited views of Lac Beauvert.
verified_facts.excerpt: conveniently located on the first floor of the Main Lodge with limited views of Lac Beauvert.

verified_facts.text: The Emerald Lounge has a fire, where hot chocolate is served in the Christmas offer.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy a warm hot chocolate by the roaring fire in the Emerald Lounge
